purpose: Keep the invariant-R0 delta architecture and frozen Llama generator while replacing an unreliable latent-Function binary gate with observable contribution evidence and preventing the existing low-information 56-call panel from being misused as scientific MS qualification.

unchanged: RS as an additive bounded strategy delta
Quality, Risk, Function and Cost remain separate
Paper 1 full primary predicate remains RS_pass AND count_pass(MP,MS,ME) >= 2
external-generator qualification is postponed until current-generator treatment qualification

amends.stage_gate_override: This V2 revision supersedes the binary latent-Function development-promotion clauses in both root_repair_v1 and baseline_and_generator_addendum_v1, including the former at-least-two independently verified Function count. It does not weaken formal Quality/Risk, leakage, selector, matched-baseline, generator-qualification, or full Paper 1 requirements.

claimed_use_review.preserved_result: One of six generator-claimed MS uses was called confirmed and five not confirmed by one first-party Codex review; no hidden use was called in thirteen safe-nonuse rows.
valid_use: diagnose very low precision of used_evidence_ids telemetry on this old-treatment sample
identify redundant, low-information and topically mismatched candidates
design clear-use, ask and hard-ignore strata for the repaired treatment
forbidden_use: an estimate of V4 R0-plus-MS treatment Function
claimed_use_review.reason: The review was single-reviewer, first-party, unblinded to treatment context, based on six self-selected telemetry-positive rows from the old treatment, and applied a counterfactual 'not explainable from current context alone' binary that is not reliably identifiable from one natural-language reply.

existing_four_arm_panel.permitted_use: Compiler/transport/IGNORE smoke design source only after a new execution manifest selects the exact subset.
defects: MS candidates were selected by most-recent-available heuristic rather than the learned selector or a prospectively reviewed opportunity stratum
many candidates are greetings, low-information, current echoes or topically unrelated facts
stale/conflict, wrong-owner and uncertain-continuity controls are absent
only twelve states have all four arms, so RS and interaction effects cannot use all sixteen states
existing_four_arm_panel.authorization: The prior request to approve all 56 calls is withdrawn. No live call identity may bind this panel as formal development qualification.

function_observability_v2.construct_boundary: Measure observable, source-supported response contribution and safe nonuse. Do not claim to recover the generator's hidden causal reasoning from a single reply.

measures: requested evidence reached the frozen compiler and generator
owner, time and source binding are valid
wrong-owner, future, answer, evidence-id and scaffold leakage

observable_contribution.role: mechanism evidence, not an ITT validity filter
observable_contribution.review_unit: Blind same-state R0 versus R0-plus-component response pair with the exact authorized source and current context.

labels.CLEAR: A concrete response difference is directly supported by the authorized source and is not merely generic warmth, length, advice or a current-context echo.
labels.PLAUSIBLE: A source-consistent bounded difference is visible, but unique attribution is not strong enough for CLEAR.
labels.UNCERTAIN: Reasonable reviewers may disagree about source attribution or component ownership; this is missing/ambiguous evidence, not automatic failure.

prohibitions: generator telemetry is never the gold label
lexical overlap is neither necessary nor sufficient
other response risk cannot erase an otherwise observable contribution; Risk is measured separately
reviewers do not reconstruct or expose a hidden chain of thought

measures: input tokens, retrieval calls, latency and USD
objective ES-MemEval QA, temporal/conflict and abstention outcomes

promote_repaired_treatment_when: structural realization passes and critical leakage/misuse is zero
Quality direction is positive or nonnegative and material Risk does not directionally worsen
the prospectively defined clear-use opportunity slice is not uniformly NONE: at least one CLEAR or at least two CLEAR-or-PLAUSIBLE cases occur across at least two owners
hard-ignore controls are mostly IGNORE/NONE and have zero critical forced use
UNCERTAIN cases remain visible and are not converted to negative labels
block_only_when: critical owner/time/source leakage or boundary misuse occurs
all prospectively defined clear-use opportunities are NONE/UNCERTAIN with no observable source-conditioned contribution
Quality or material Risk moves directionally against the repaired treatment
the panel lacks enough prospectively reviewed opportunities and controls to answer the treatment question

formal_first_pm_ms_closure.EvoEmo_response: Report CLEAR/PLAUSIBLE/NONE/UNCERTAIN by owner on the frozen learned-ON and matched-OFF slices; require nonzero reproducible observable contribution and zero critical misuse, but do not require an 0.80 Function rate or perfect reviewer agreement.
formal_first_pm_ms_closure.ES_MemEval_objective: Require objective memory-required QA benefit versus no-memory and accuracy/risk noninferiority at lower input cost versus typed-memory fixed-high. This is the less subjective external evidence that MS retrieves useful information.
formal_first_pm_ms_closure.combined_interpretation: MS mechanism support comes from observable EvoEmo response contribution plus objective ES-MemEval memory value; neither a single Codex label nor generator telemetry can establish or veto the head alone.

panel_v2_requirements.scientific_role: Treatment qualification only. A later confirmatory policy run must use the frozen learned selector rather than oracle/opportunity-balanced sampling.
panel_v2_requirements.population: Fresh development states, at most one state per owner, disjoint from external confirmation outcomes.

minimum_strata.CLEAR_USE: at least 4 states from 4 owners with a specific, relevant, non-redundant strictly past fact
minimum_strata.ASK: at least 2 states from 2 owners where continuity is genuinely uncertain and a tentative check could help
minimum_strata.IGNORE: at least 4 states from 4 owners, including current-context echo, topically mismatched/low-information, wrong-owner, and stale-or-conflicting controls

panel_v2_requirements.RS_coverage: At least 12 states must have all four M0+R0/M0+RS/MS+R0/MS+RS arms. RS main effect and RS-by-MS interaction use only the complete four-arm eligible intersection; MS main effect may additionally use valid two-arm states and must report the denominator separately.
panel_v2_requirements.call_budget: Prefer no more than 64 generator calls. Reuse no response from the old treatment as a V2 arm.
panel_v2_requirements.candidate_review: Opportunity strata are frozen before generation by source/current-context inspection with arm outcomes unavailable. They qualify the treatment and do not become learned-selector labels.
panel_v2_requirements.next_action: Rebuild the panel zero-API, machine-audit its strata and hashes, then present one exact run identity and cost cap for approval.

first_pm_milestone.name: SELECTIVE_RS_PLUS_MS_PM
first_pm_milestone.scope: A bounded selective strategy plus session-memory PM under the frozen generator.
first_pm_milestone.external_chain: RS closes on ESConv plus EvoEmo; MS closes on EvoEmo plus ES-MemEval; the three tracks are complementary and not pooled.
first_pm_milestone.allowed_claim: The selective RS+MS system preserves Quality/Risk, reduces unnecessary resource cost, shows adaptive value over rule/random/static controls, and transports memory value to objective QA if all corresponding gates pass.

full_paper1_primary.consequence: Finishing the RS+MS milestone before MP is scientifically useful but does not satisfy the current full Paper 1 predicate. If MP is later added to the claimed final system, affected EvoEmo and ES-MemEval final-system comparisons must be augmented or rerun under the frozen expanded policy; pure RS+MS results cannot be relabeled as the MP-inclusive system.
